grammar.summary: 本课学习被动语态与 be worried about 状态表达。

points.title: 被动语态（动作接收者视角）
points.explanation: Ted was worried / the bicycle was picked up / he is being questioned. 现在进行被动：is being + 过去分词。

examples.en: The bicycle was picked up by the police.

points.title: 现在完成被动
points.explanation: has been found / has been questioned 完成被动组合，表"已被找到/被询问"。

examples.en: Ted was surprised to learn the news.
examples.cn: Ted 听到这个消息很惊讶。

exercises.q: It's too late to go to the pictures. Why don't we call the whole thing ___ ?
I called ___ you five times yesterday. Were you out?
We called ___ to him but he could not hear Us.
I called ___ the post office on my way to work.
